report.answer: Application-level route handling is wired up in lib/application.js: app.init() lazily creates an internal Router instance (via a getter on `this.router`), app.use() delegates middleware mounting to `this.router.use(...)`, and the `methods.forEach` block plus `app.all` delegate HTTP-verb methods (get/post/etc.) to `this.route(path)[method](...)`. The router itself is NOT implemented in this repo — it's an external npm dependency, required as `var Router = require('router')` (line 26 of application.js), and listed in package.json dependencies as `"router": "^2.2.0"`.
